questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: In 'Marriage Procession of Dara Shikoh', the groom Dara Shikoh is mounted on a decorated brown stallion wearing a jewel-studded pearl veil (sehra).
Statement II: The marriage procession took place in absolute silence in an empty forest with no music or people.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Validates both statements as accurate NCERT facts.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid NCERT facts erroneously.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Statement I is correct: Dara Shikoh rides a brown horse wearing a pearl sehra. Statement II is incorrect: the scene is an exuberant royal extravaganza packed with cheering crowds, musicians, fireworks, and caparisoned elephants.
Hence Option D is correct.
Hence, option (A) is correct.

questionText:
Match the artistic landmark in List I with its description in List II:

List I:
(A) Chand Bibi Playing Polo
(B) Ibrahim Adil Shah II with Tanpura
(C) Nujum al-Ulum (1570 A.D.)
(D) Sultan Abdullah Qutb Shah

List II:
(I) Bijapur astronomical and astrological treatise with hundreds of colored illustrations
(II) Golconda equestrian painting showing four noble women playing polo on galloping steeds
(III) Master portrait showing the Bijapur sultan in mystical reverie playing a stringed tanpura
(IV) Golconda ruler whose opulent, courtly portraiture showcased diamond-encrusted wealth

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-IV, B-III, C-II, D-I
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A-II, B-III, C-I, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-IV, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-III, B-II, C-I, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Chand Bibi Playing Polo is Golconda's equestrian work; Ibrahim with Tanpura is Bijapur's mystic portrait; Nujum al-Ulum is the 1570 Bijapur treatise; Abdullah Qutb Shah ruled Golconda.
Hence Option D is correct.
Hence, option (B) is the correct match.

questionText:
Arrange the historical events surrounding the painting of 'Falcon on a Bird-Rest' in chronological order:
(A) Shah Abbas of Persia sends a magnificent white royal hunting falcon as a diplomatic gift to Jahangir
(B) The royal falcon arrives in India and is admired by Jahangir for its exceptional speed and beauty
(C) A palace cat attacks and fatally wounds the prized royal hunting bird
(D) Grief-stricken, Jahangir commands Ustad Mansur to paint the falcon's portrait for the imperial memoirs

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: A, B, C, D

The sequence moves from the Persian gift, to its arrival, its tragic mauling by a cat, and Jahangir commanding Mansur to paint its likeness.
Hence Option C is correct.
